allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

terms.description: Array of domain-specific terms with definitions, used to establish shared vocabulary across specs.

items.description: A single glossary term with its definition, domain classification, and canonical references.

term_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this glossary term (e.g., 'term-session-token').

term.description: The glossary term as it appears in natural language, minimum 2 characters.

acronym.description: Optional uppercase acronym for this term (e.g., 'JWT', 'API').

definition.description: Precise definition of the term in the project context, minimum 20 characters.

domain.description: Knowledge domain this term belongs to, in kebab-case (e.g., 'authentication', 'data-storage').

units.description: Unit of measurement if this term represents a measurable quantity (e.g., 'ms', 'MB/s').

term_ref.description: Canonical reference linking this term to the canonical registry.

acronym_ref.description: Canonical reference for the acronym in the canonical registry.

unit_ref.description: Canonical reference for the unit of measurement in the canonical registry.
